notes.title: Removing from Early Access and New Campaign Levels - August Edition
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41704293/15a37e02a235589133a7da26767094ffdb6a0439.png

Hi Ragdolls!
We are excited to finally drop this update and updating our game from steam Early Access!
This update will lay out some of the groundwork for the upcoming new user requested fixes and features that we are working on right now. In this update, we did a ton of bug fixes and improvements. We also added a few new fun things to the game to enjoy both the sandbox mode and Campaign mode.

Here is the full update list!

 Additional 14 NEW LEVELS in Campaign mode
 New Steam Achievements for completing each level
 You can now speedrun each individual level and unlock their achievement
 Updated Ui modes
 Fixed language settings and their respective UI
 improved player key response


Also! a quick update on development in general.
We have some really exciting new content cooking for Ragdolls playground.
We can’t wait to start sharing work in progress 
this week on our Twitter! Make sure you follow us there!

More fixes and improvements coming soon!

For all the latest news, follow us on
Twitter
Discord

https://i.imgur.com/v4jpa5e.gif

Thank you to everyone who shared their feedback with me for improving the game and showing their support for ragdolls playground .
I hope you enjoy this new, more casual ragdoll game as much as we do!

Stay safe! 💙💛
~JannerBros (Developer)

notes.title: WATCH THE DEVELOPER PLAY Ragdolls Playground: The Sandbox
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/jRyVwji.gif

Ragdolls Playground is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the ragdoll, tools, and leave you to play. This game is for people who enjoy Building, throwing around ragdolls but want it to be more detailed, satisfying, and feel more free while doing so.

https://i.imgur.com/zB4Qjrx.gif

There's more than enough to play with.
https://i.imgur.com/tDBOVEk.gif

Every object has a set of properties that describe how it interacts with anything in the world and there are Hundreds of Inventory Items already and more new content is being added and optimizations being made regularly. Please watch the latest Ragdolls Playground trailers and Our Discord server to see the game’s latest state.

There's more than enough to test with.

Some stuff is SHARP, Some stuff SHOOTS, Some stuff EXPLODES.
https://i.imgur.com/QWsrGwM.gif

The game contains a varied collection of projectile based weapons, Jump pads, and Obstacles for you to play with. There are different explosives that vary in destructive power as well as the manner in which they release their energy.

There's more than enough Ragdolls to play with.
https://i.imgur.com/Tvl8lST.gif

There are more types of ragdolls and each ragdoll will have their own set of properties that describe how it interacts with anything in the world. You can make the Ragdoll Follow, Attack each other, simulate battles, or use them to test, usually on death machines that you crafted, to play around with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41704293/71eebb65de764d28b501595de7f887a057c1bc90.png

FEATURES

Sandbox mode
Simulation mode
Build anything (Usually death machines)
Massive playground
Drivable Vehicles
Destructible Items
More inventory items
More unique Ragdolls
More Obstacles
Level Creator
Customization: Customize most of the object's Properties, Functions, colors and re-size them to fit your need.


https://i.imgur.com/v4jpa5e.gif

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41704293/3e7347bf14c285be7d4585b5fb9b8b0db905f0f9.png

Hi Ragdolls!
We are excited to finally launch our Demo for Ragdolls playground: The sandbox
This demo will allow you to test and understand the basic features of the game. And some of the features are locked and will be available while launching the game in Early Access after a massive update. If you enjoyed the demo, wishlist the game on steam to get notified during the final game launch.

In this demo update, we did a ton of bug fixes and improvements. We also added a few new fun things to the game to enjoy the sandbox mode.

Here is the full update list!

 Fixed game saving system.
 Added new physics contained obstacles.
 Fixed help menu.
 Added pop up controls during the gameplay.
 Added new Ragdolls and troops for simulation.
 Fixed game mode and simulation mode toggling.
 Fixed ragdolls collision while using vehicles.
 Fixed spawn gun ghost object visibility while driving the vehicle.
 Fixed disabling and enabling respawning while using different tools.
 Fixed Ragdoll navigation system for performance.
 Fixed player changing into ragdoll while in build mode.
 Fixed all obstacle collision.
 Improved ragdoll interaction with obstacle.
 Fixed Ragdoll activation while in build mode.
 Added Controls bar in the main menu.


Also! a quick update on development in general.
We have some really exciting new content cooking for Ragdolls playground.

notes.title: Devblog 4 is here : Big Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41704293/461062121d850db0e57a733da5de4f4c668b409c.png

Hi Ragdolls!
We are excited to finally drop this massive game update!
This update will lay out some of the groundwork for the upcoming new sandbox mode that we are working on right now. In this update, we did a ton of additional player controlled setting options, bug fixes and improvements. We also added a few new fun things to the game to enjoy the sandbox mode.

https://i.imgur.com/c7RpjwK.gif

Here is the full update list!

 Added a toggle between Build mode and game/simulation mode that allows you to build and test the levels easily and resets the position of the objects automatically when changing to game mode after simulating which allows you to modify your levels easily.
 Added settings menu for building shapes and props that give you options for changing the weight, gravity of the building objects and simulation ON/OFF settings to define whether the object will be affected when toggling between the game simulation mode and build mode.
 Added environment settings for landscape, sky, sun and player which gives you freedom to modify the entire default environment settings.
 Added reset buttons for all the settings to reset the entire settings in a single click to their default values.
 Added options to change the color of the landscape.
 Added an option to ON/OFF the grid for landscape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41704293/f66397089237541c796256c6df99fa9c50739a45.png

 Added options to change player default run and walk speed.
 Added options to change player default color.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41704293/ad34bea45de646f308fed98f6b9c0665d2bc2239.png

 Fixed some bugs for performance issues and the game is running smoothly now even at decent configuration.
 Fixed main menu options and a cool main menu simulation.
 Fixed help menu options while switching between different tools.
 Added user info options in the game while selecting tools.


https://i.imgur.com/DNQqra0.gif
